arabic text: KABHI DARBAR ME PESHI KO BULATE HAI HUMAIN\nKABHI DARWAZE PE AA AAKE SATATE HAI HUMAIN
english translation text: AT TIMES THEY HAVE SUMMONED US TO THE COURT\nAT TIMES THEY HAVE TORMENTED US AT OUR DOORSTEP

arabic text: MERE YEH PHOOL SE BACCHE POOCH TE HAI YEHI MUJHSE\nKYA KHATA HAM SE HUI HAI.....
english translation text: MY BEAUTIFUL CHILDREN KEEP ASKING OF ME\nO WHAT IS OUR CRIME?

arabic text: TERI ZEHRA (SA) PE MUSIBAT KI GHADI HAI\nHAI BABA.....TERI ZEHRA (SA) PE MUSIBAT KI GHADI HAI
english translation text: IT IS THE TIME OF CALAMITY UPON YOUR ZEHRA!\nO FATHER! IT IS THE TIME OF CALAMITY UPON YOUR ZEHRA!

arabic text: SHARM AATI HAI BHALA TUM KO BATAUN KAISE\nYEH TAMACHON KE NISHA TUM KO DIKHA UN KAISE
english translation text: I AM SO EMBARRASSED, O HOW CAN I TELL YOU?\nHOW CAN I SHOW YOU THE BRUISES FROM THE SLAPS ON MY FACE?

arabic text: TUM NA PEHCHAN SAKON GE DEKH KAR MUJHSE KAHON GE\nKYA MERI ZEHRA (SA) YEHI HAI.....
english translation text: YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RECOGNIZE ME; YOU WILL BEHOLD AND SAY TO ME\nIS THIS MY ZEHRA?

arabic text: YEH AZIAT YEH KHANOSHI NAHI DEKHI JAATI\nMUJHSE TANAHI ALI (AS) KI NAHI DEKHI JATI
english translation text: THIS TORMENT, THIS SILENCE, IS UNBEARABLE\nI CANNOT BEAR TO SEE THE LONELINESS OF ALI

arabic text: TERA PAYGAM SUNA NE, HAQ WILAYAT KA BATANE\nZEHRA (SA) GHAR GHAR GAI HAI.....
english translation text: TO CONVEY YOUR MESSAGE; TO CONVEY THE TRUTH OF HIS WILAYAT\nZEHRA HAS GONE FROM DOOR TO DOOR

arabic text: AAP KE SOG ME TARIKH NA DEKHA GAYA GHAR\nAAG DARWAZE PE UMMAT NE LAGA DI AAKAR
english translation text: OUR HOME WAS NOT SEEN DIMMED IN GRIEF OF YOUR LOSS\nYOUR NATION CAME TO OUR DOOR AND SET IT ABLAZE

arabic text: BABA JAAN BAAD TUMHARE DEKHIYE GHAR ME HAMARE\nRAUSHNI KAISE HUI HAI.....
english translation text: DEAR FATHER, LOOK! AFTER YOU, IN OUR HOUSE\nHOW THE TORCH HAS BLAZED!

arabic text: KABRE ZEHRA (SA) SE TAKALUM YEH SADA AATI HAI\nKITNI SADION SE MERE KABR PE VEERANI HAI
english translation text: FROM THE GRAVE OF ZEHRA ARISES A VOICE\nFOR CENTURIES HAS DESOLATION PERVADED UPON MY GRAVE

arabic text: PHOOL TURBAT PE CHADHA NE KE DIYA LAA KE JALA NE\nKYA MEDINE ME KOI HAI
english translation text: IS THERE ANYONE IN MADINA?\nTO LAY FLOWERS ON MY HEADSTONE, TO LIGHT A CANDLE…

arabic text: HAI BABA… TERI ZEHRA PE MUSIBAT KI GHADI HAI
english translation text: O FATHER… A MOMENT OF CALAMITY HAS FALLEN UPON YOUR ZEHRA.

arabic text: KAISE DARWAZA HATA-OON, KAISE MOHSIN KO BACHA-OON\nSAANS SEENE ME RUKI HAI
english translation text: HOW DO I MOVE THIS DOOR? HOW DO I SAVE MOHSIN?\nMY BREATH IS TRAPPED WITHIN MY CHEST.

arabic text:
HATH ME JISKE MERA HATH DIYA THA TUMNE
KEHKE MANKUNTO JISSE MAULA KAHA THA TUMNE
MAINE HAR MOD PE BABA, SAATH USKA HAI NIBHAYA
HAA(N) MERA JURAM YEHI HAI
english translation text:
THE ONE WHOSE HAND YOU PLACED INTO MINE,
THE ONE YOU DECLARED AS MAULA THROUGH 'MAN KUNTO MAULA',
O FATHER, I STAYED LOYAL TO HIM AT EVERY TURN—
YES, THAT IS MY ONLY 'CRIME.'

arabic text:
TERI UMMAT NE BANA DI HAI YEH HAALATH BABA
KOI PASLI BHI NAHI MERI SALAMAT BABA
SAANS LETI HUM MAIN JIS DAM, GHUT NE LAGTA HAI MERA DAM
SIRF MARNE KI KAMI HA
english translation text:
YOUR UMMAH HAS BROUGHT ME TO THIS STATE, O FATHER.
NOT EVEN A SINGLE RIB OF MINE REMAINS UNBROKEN.
EACH BREATH I TAKE FEELS SUFFOCATING—
THE ONLY THING LEFT IS FOR ME TO DIE.
